summary.text: Mark McElroy is serving his fifth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 62, which includes all of Lee and Phillips counties and portions of Monroe, Arkansas and Desha counties.

paragraphs.text: McElroy's past service includes serving as Desha County Judge and as a Justice of the Peace in Desha County; the House lists his occupation as retired county judge, farmer and auctioneer.

sources.title: Mark D. McElroy - Arkansas House of Representatives
